parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: The unique ID of the data masking task. You can obtain the ID of a data masking task from the return value of the [DescribeDataMaskingTasks](~~DescribeDataMaskingTasks~~) operation.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:

- **zh\_cn**: Chinese (Simplified). This is the default value.

- **en\_us**: English (US).
